4. **is-sorted**: Fixed the comparison logic to properly check if xs[i] <= xs[i+1] (allowing equal adjacent elements) rather than only checking <.

5. **longest-run**: Fixed by using locals properly and passing i (starting at 0) to run-helper.

6. **has-pair-sum**: Restructured the outer/inner check to properly handle the if-branch stack effects.

7. **count-distinct**: Reordered recursive calls to check from i+1 onwards to avoid counting the same value twice.

8. **merge-sorted**: Corrected parameter order in recursive calls and main to match the effect signature (xs, ys, i, j, result).

9. **digits**: Fixed stack ordering in digits-helper and reverse-digits, and used locals in main to bind n.

10. **primes-up-to**: Reordered parameters in prime-generator recursive call.

11. **histogram, sort, ledger, allocate-batch**: Fixed stack ordering and branch consistency issues.
